description: A modern interior scene with a bold red wall featuring a recessed arch. Two teal armchairs with sleek, curved designs are symmetrically placed on either side of a small red table. The table holds a black vase with delicate white flowers, adding a touch of elegance. An arched floor lamp with a minimalist design extends over one of the chairs, providing a soft light. The floor is a light wood, contrasting with the vibrant colors of the furniture and wall.
